summary: Build ISO/IEC 38500 IT governance skills, prepare for the PECB exam, and review credential requirements and course details.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who contribute to IT governance decisions, oversight, and review. It is relevant if you help apply ISO/IEC 38500 principles or support governance responsibilities across an organization.
prerequisites: PECB states that you should have a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 38500 and comprehensive knowledge of IT Governance before attending.
